items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were doing a film with Count Basie and Billie Holiday and Sugar Chile Robinson.

ctx.x: We were doing a film with Count Basie and Billie Holiday and Sugar Chile Robinson. The band was Basie, Gus Johnson, Freddie Green, Wardell Gray, me, and Jimmie Lewis. Buddy DeFranco was in the band. Buddy DeFranco – we got ready to film at Snader Productions in Hollywood . . .
Oh, this is why – how the other gentleman came in – Marshal came in . . .
